test_dataloader_iterable: test the DataLoader class by iterating over a list of integers and verifying sorted output
test_dataloader_preprocess: test the DataLoader preprocessor parameter by applying a doubling function to each item in the source
test_dataloader_output_order: test the DataLoader output_order parameter to verify input order preservation versus completion order
test_dataloader_batch: test the DataLoader batch_size and drop_last parameters to verify batching behavior with and without dropping
test_dataloader_aggregate: test the DataLoader aggregator parameter by applying a statistics function to each batch of items
